dataset.note: Reference arrays only. The 196 GiB Zarr and the 95 GiB replay are not on ICE and are not needed.

geometry.note: FRAME_CAP is deliberately unreachable; the 16:00:00 partition wall ends every arm. TIMEOUT is safe because log_dir is under /data (persistent scratch), so loss is bounded by save_interval.

baseline.source: local 10B run, W&B 4ndjy36f, scored on the fixed protocol
baseline.protocol: frame 0, --randomization none, MODE actions, 1024 envs, 500 steps
baseline.note: Still descending at 4.03B at ~0.25 mm/B. An arm must beat the control at the SAME frame count and clear that drift.

jobs.failure: Dropped 2026-08-05 after two failures at ~50 s: 5567113 on gpu:h200:1 and 5567121 on gpu:h100:1, the configuration proven by the 2026-08-03 physx 5B run. Neither the GPU nor the GPU policy guard is the cause -- the H100 log shows 'PhysX GPU policy accepted: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3' then 'AppLauncher initialization complete', so Kit starts on Hopper. The process exits after config parsing and before env construction with status 0 and no traceback; only the missing workload success marker reports it. The /isaac-sim/kit/data write errors are non-fatal noise. Reproduce interactively at --num_envs 64 before resubmitting.

jobs.delta: rollout 6 -> 24, minibatch scaled 4x to hold update density

job_name_caveat: Slurm job names are timestamp-derived (abl129k-YYYYMMDD-HHMM) and several arms share one, so the queue cannot attribute an arm. This file and agent.logger.log_dir are the mapping.

scoring.compare_at: the largest 50M-frame multiple every arm reached; arms end on the wall, not at equal frame counts
scoring.warning: completed_requested_horizon_rate is not a quality metric here: the median clip is 287 frames against a 500-step horizon, so most episodes end because the reference ran out. Never score arms on training-time curves -- under the sonic adaptive sampler they hid a real 25.8 -> 23.4 mm improvement.
